title: Web Developer
description:
Candescent is a forward\-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in\-person channels.
   

  

 Our Experience\-Led, Intelligence\-Driven approach combines human\-centered design with data, automation, and cloud\-based innovation. Built on an API\-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.
   

  

**Job Summary**
*Role Purpose*
 Candescent is seeking a skilled Web Developer to build, maintain, and continuously improve our website from one of our India office locations. You will work closely with marketing, design, and strategy stakeholders to bring pages and campaigns to life quickly and cleanly, with a strong focus on hands\-on Webflow development and integrating web experiences with Marketo for lead capture and marketing automation.
   

  

 This is a role for someone who enjoys turning designs into polished, performant, well\-structured pages and is comfortable owning the technical execution of a marketing website. You will work under the direction of the senior web developer in India, who will set priorities, review your work, and provide technical coaching.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities And Deliverables**
*What you will be responsible for and what you will do*
**Build \& Maintain**
* Build, update, and maintain website pages, templates, and components in Webflow, following design specifications and brand guidelines.
* Maintain clean, scalable Webflow CMS structures including collections, fields, and dynamic content that non\-technical teammates can manage.
* Implement responsive, accessible, cross\-browser designs from Figma or similar design files.
* Perform regular site maintenance including fixing broken links, resolving bugs, managing redirects, and monitoring uptime.


**Marketing Systems \& Tracking**
* Integrate and troubleshoot Marketo forms, tracking scripts, and landing pages within the website, ensuring accurate lead capture and data flow into marketing automation.
* Implement and maintain tracking and analytics tags such as GA4, Google Tag Manager, and Marketo Munchkin in coordination with marketing stakeholders.
* Support A/B testing initiatives by implementing test variants and experiment code on landing pages.


**Performance \& Quality**
* Optimise pages for site speed, Core Web Vitals, and overall performance.
* Ensure SEO best practices are followed in markup, including meta tags, structured data, semantic HTML, URL structure, and redirects.
* Translate designs accurately, with strong attention to spacing, typography, and visual detail.


**Collaboration \& Ways of Working**
* Collaborate with designers, marketers, and project managers to scope, estimate, and deliver web requests on time.
* Work closely with the senior web developer in India, who will set priorities, review work, and provide technical direction and coaching.
* Maintain basic documentation of site structure, components, and workflows.
* Maintain a working schedule with sufficient overlap with US business hours on at least a few days each week to enable live collaboration, reviews, and handoffs.


**Experience**
*Demonstrated skills, competencies, and required experience*
* 3–5 years of experience building and maintaining websites, including hands\-on Webflow development across Designer and CMS.
* Solid understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Experience integrating and troubleshooting Marketo or a comparable marketing automation platform for forms and tracking on a website.
* Familiarity with responsive design principles and cross\-browser and device testing.
* Basic understanding of SEO fundamentals as they relate to site markup and structure.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to translate designs accurately.
* Good communication skills and the ability to manage multiple requests and projects at once.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced marketing environment with shifting priorities.


**Qualifications \& Preferred Distinctions**
*Additional accomplishments*
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Web Development, Design, or a related field; equivalent professional experience and a portfolio of live sites will be considered.
* Experience implementing tracking and analytics tags such as GA4 and Google Tag Manager is preferred.
* Experience with other no\-code or low\-code website platforms and content management systems is preferred.
* Familiarity with version control such as Git for custom code embeds is a plus.
* Basic experience with A/B testing tools is a plus.
* Experience with project management tools such as Smartsheet or Jira is a plus.
* Experience supporting financial services, technology, B2B, SaaS, or enterprise software brands is preferred.
* Experience collaborating across geographies and time zones is helpful.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Web pages and campaigns are built accurately, on time, and match design intent.
* Forms and tracking reliably capture and pass lead data into Marketo without errors.
* The site stays fast, functional, and free of recurring bugs.
* Webflow CMS is organised and maintainable by both developers and marketers.
* Requests are delivered predictably, with clear communication on status and blockers.


**What Will Make You Successful**
* Care for the small details that separate a good build from a sloppy one.
* Willingness to ask questions early rather than guessing at requirements.
* Strong attention to detail and a high standard of craft and quality.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and shifting priorities without losing momentum.
* Clear, proactive communication with stakeholders across geographies and time zones.
* A collaborative, low\-ego working style and a genuine willingness to give and receive feedback.
* Strong organisation, follow\-through, and accountability in a global, fast\-paced environment.


**Statement to Third Party Agencies**
 To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

title: Senior Engineer - Linux device drivers
description:
**Company**
 Qualcomm India Private Limited
   

  

**Job Area**
 Engineering Group, Engineering Group \> Software Engineering
   

  

**General Summary**
 Architecting, designing, and developing multi\-processor multimedia and AI frameworks that span across CPU, DSP, and NPU.
   

  

 Developing high\-performance drivers and runtime libraries to unlock the full potential of specialized DSP and AI hardware. Linux Kernel , Memory architecture, PCIe Drivers, C/C\+\+
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Drive development and optimization of Linux device drivers, firmware modules, and system\-level components.
   

  

 Collaborate cross\-functionally with hardware, software, and QA teams to ensure seamless integration and delivery.
   

  

 Contribute to design reviews, code reviews, and technical documentation.
   

  

 Investigate and resolve complex system\-level issues across hardware and software boundaries.
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in embedded systems, Linux device drivers, or firmware development.
   

  

 4\+ years of professional experience in C and C\+\+ programming.
   

  

 Experience contributing to open\-source projects, particularly in the Linux kernel community.
   

  

 Good understanding of system architecture, memory management, and performance optimization.
   

  

**Preferred/Bonus Skills**
 Experience with RPC (Remote Procedure Call) frameworks.
   

  

 Familiarity with ARM SMMU (System Memory Management Unit).
   

  

 Knowledge of Linux DMA buffers and memory sharing mechanisms.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 2\+ years of Software Engineering or related work experience.


 OR
   

  

 Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field and 1\+ year of Software Engineering or related work experience.

 PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or related field.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Devices - Türkiye
description:
**All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.** 



  

 About JumpCloud®
   


 JumpCloud® is the AI\-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.
 


  


  
 


  

**JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.** 
  





  





  


 As we continue to grow JumpCloud internationally, we are hiring software engineers to expand our product. You’ll have the opportunity to play a key role in the success and development of our engineering teams in addition to growing your own career.
 


  


  
 


  


**About the Role:** 



  


 In this role, you will specifically work on the Device Management (MDM / Endpoint Management) vertical at JumpCloud, the role shifts focus from broad cloud microservices to deeply understanding operating system internals (macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android) and how they communicate with the cloud.
 


  


 In the Device Management vertical, you will build the software that allows IT administrators to remotely configure, patch, secure, and monitor thousands of endpoints from a single pane of glass. You will work on cross\-OS device management engines, mobile device management / Declarative Device Management(MDM/DDM) telemetry, custom system agents, and zero\-touch enrollment pipelines. This role balances local client\-side programming (interacting with the OS) and building high\-availability cloud APIs.
 


  


  
 


  






  




**What you’ll be doing:** 
  
* Primarily working with Go and Node.js for cross\-platform applications on Windows, macOS, and Linux
  
* Gaining or utilizing expertise in areas like Windows services, kernels, Event Loggers, Mac Launch daemons, and macOS internals
  
* Collaborating with architects, UX designers, and DevOps to ensure our systems are highly available, scalable, and deliver exceptional user experiences
  
* Working within a Scrum framework to drive agile development
  
* Learning and working with mTLS protocols and related security concepts. Prior experience in these areas is a plus
  
* Using OAuth/OIDC flows for secure user authentication and service access
  
* Writing Unit test cases, Functional test cases, acceptance tests along with automating these test cases
  
* Contributing to the future of our Device Management services by participating in strategic planning and scoping sessions with product managers
  
* Embodying our core values: building strong connections, thinking big, and striving to improve by 1% every day
  

  



  




**We’re looking for:** 
  
* 7\-10 years experience developing MAC, Windows, or  Linux applications (including integration with third\-party applications) in any modern language (Python, Java) or Golang. Experience in one of them is a must
  
* Experience using one of the public cloud providers (AWS, GCP or Azure) with CI/CD pipelines (preferably Github Action) to build, test and deploy. Knowledge of containerization technologies and orchestration with Kubernetes
  
* Strong hands\-on experience in backend software or full stack development is a must
  
* Working knowledge of Swift, C Sharp, C\+\+ would be an added advantage
  
* Working knowledge on device MDM would be an added advantage
  
* Willingness to mentor junior members of the team
  
* Bonus points if you have experience with Services, event logger, Kernel in Windows OS and/or Launch demon, app hosting in Mac
  

  






  




  


**Where you’ll be working/Location:** 



  



 JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
 



  


  
 


  


**You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.** 



  


  
 


  



 Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on\-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.
 



  


  
 


  


**Language:** 



  



 JumpCloud has teams in 15\+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently.  Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.
 



  


  
 


  


**Why JumpCloud?** 

  
 



  



 If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS\-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.  
 



  



  
 



  



 One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." \- Rajat Bhargava, CEO
 



  



  
 



  



 Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud.  Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.   
 



  



  
 



  



 JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
 



  


  
 


  



**Scam Notice:** 




  



 Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.
 



  


  
 


  



 All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at recruiting@jumpcloud.com with the subject line "Scam Notice" 
 



  



  
 



  



 \#BI\-Remote
 



  


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans. Please see our Privacy Policy (https://jumpcloud.com/privacy) for more information about our personal data practices.

title: Software Engineer, Distributed Data Systems (IN)
description:
**About Onehouse**
 Onehouse is a mission\-driven company dedicated to freeing data from data platform lock\-in. We deliver the industry’s most interoperable data lakehouse through a cloud\-native managed service built on Apache Hudi. Onehouse enables organizations to ingest data at scale with minute\-level freshness, centrally store it, and make available to any downstream query engine and use case (from traditional analytics to real\-time AI / ML).
   

  

 We are a team of self\-driven, inspired, and seasoned builders that have created large\-scale data systems and globally distributed platforms that sit at the heart of some of the largest enterprises out there including Uber, Snowflake, AWS, Linkedin, Confluent and many more. Riding off a fresh $35M Series B backed by Craft, Greylock and Addition Ventures, we're now at $68M total funding and looking for rising talent to grow with us and become future leaders of the team. Come help us build the world's best fully managed and self\-optimizing data lake platform!
   

  

**The Community You Will Join**
 When you join Onehouse, you're joining a team of passionate professionals tackling the deeply technical challenges of building a 2\-sided engineering product. Our engineering team serves as the bridge between the worlds of open source and enterprise: contributing directly to and growing Apache Hudi (already used at scale by global enterprises like Uber, Amazon, ByteDance etc) and concurrently defining a new industry category \- the transactional data lake. The Data Infrastructure team is the grounding heartbeat to all of this. We live and breathe databases, building cornerstone infrastructure by working under Hudi's hood to solving incredibly complex optimization and systems problems.
   

  

**The Impact You Will Drive:**
- As a foundational member of the Data Infrastructure team, you will productionize the next generation of our data tech stack by building the software and data features that actually process all of the data we ingest.

 Accelerate our open source enterprise flywheel by working on the guts of Apache Hudi's transactional engine and optimizing it for diverse Onehouse customer workloads.
 - Act as a SME to deepen our teams' expertise on database internals, query engines, storage and/or stream processing.

**A Typical Day:**
* Design new concurrency control and transactional capabilities that maximize throughput for competing writers.
* Design and implement new indexing schemes, specifically optimized for incremental data processing and analytical query performance.
* Design systems that help scale and streamline metadata and data access from different query/compute engines.
* Solve hard optimization problems to improve the efficiency (increase performance and lower cost) of distributed data processing algorithms over a Kubernetes cluster.
* Leverage data from existing systems to find inefficiencies, and quickly build and validate prototypes.
* Collaborate with other engineers to implement and deploy, safely rollout the optimized solutions in production.


**What You Bring to the Table:**
* Strong, object\-oriented design and coding skills (Java and/or C/C\+\+ preferably on a UNIX or Linux platform).
* Experience with inner workings of distributed (multi\-tiered) systems, algorithms, and relational databases.
* You embrace ambiguous/undefined problems with an ability to think abstractly and articulate technical challenges and solutions.
* An ability to prioritize across feature development and tech debt with urgency and speed.
* An ability to solve complex programming/optimization problems.
* An ability to quickly prototype optimization solutions and analyze large/complex data.
* Robust and clear communication skills.
* Nice to haves (but not required):
* Experience working with database systems, Query Engines or Spark codebases.
* Experience in optimization mathematics (linear programming, nonlinear optimization).
* Existing publications of optimizing large\-scale data systems in top\-tier distributed system conferences.
* PhD degree with 2\+ years industry experience in solving and delivering high\-impact optimization projects.


**How We'll Take Care Of You**
* Equity Compensation; our success is your success with eligible participation in our company equity plan
* Health \& Well\-being; we'll invest in your physical and mental well\-being by reimbursing up to 20,000 INR for your monthly insurance premium
* Financial Future; we'll invest in your financial well\-being by making this role eligible for the provident fund of which Onehouse will contribute up to 1800 INR/month
* Location; we are a remote\-friendly company (internationally distributed across N. America \+ India), though some roles will be subject to in\-person requirements in alignment with the needs of the business
* Generous Time Off; unlimited PTO (mandatory 1 week/year minimum), uncapped sick days and 17 paid company holidays
* Food \& Meal Allowance; weekly lunch stipend, in\-office snacks/drinks
* Equipment; we'll provide you with the equipment you need to be successful and a one\-time $500 (USD) stipend for your initial office/desk setup
* Child Bonding!; 26 weeks off for birthing and 12 weeks for surrogate and adoptive parents \- fully paid so you can focus your energy on your newest addition


**House Values**
**One Team**
 Optimize for the company, your team, self \- in that order. We may fight long and hard in the trenches, take care of your co\-workers with empathy. We give more than we take to build the one house, that everyone dreams of being part of.
   

  

**Tough \& Persevering**
 We are building our company in a very large, fast\-growing but highly competitive space. Life will get tough sometimes. We take hardships in the stride, be positive, focus all energy on the path forward and develop a champion's mindset to overcome odds. Always day one!
   

  

**Keep Making It Better Always**
 Rome was not built in a day; If we can get 1% better each day for one year, we'll end up thirty\-seven times better. This means being organized, communicating promptly, taking even small tasks seriously, tracking all small ideas, and paying it forward.
   

  

**Think Big, Act Fast**
 We have tremendous scope for innovation, but we will still be judged by impact over time. Big, bold ideas still need to be strategized against priorities, broken down, set in rapid motion, measure, refine, repeat. Great execution is what separates promising companies from proven unicorns.
   

  

**Be Customer Obsessed**
 Everyone has the responsibility to drive towards the best experience for the customer, be an OSS user or a paid customer. If something is broken, own it, say something, do something; never ignore. Be the change that you want to see in the company.
   

  

**Pay Range Transparency**
 Onehouse is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. Our job titles may span more than one career level. The pay range(s) for this role is listed above and represents the base salary range for non\-commissionable roles or on\-target earnings for commissionable roles. Actual compensation packages are dependent upon several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to: job\-related skills, depth of transferable experience, relevant certifications and training, business needs, market demands and specific work location. Based on the factors above, Onehouse utilizes the full width of the range; the base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. The total compensation package for this position will also include eligibility for equity options and the benefits listed above.
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Senior Business Intelligence Developer(India)
description:
**Title: Senior Business Intelligence Developer**
**Job Type: Contract**
**Location: India \| Remote**
**Send Your resumes at hr@irow9\.com**
**Job Summary**
 Looking for a Senior Business Intelligence Developer with 7\+ years of BI development experience and strong hands\-on expertise in Power BI, Tableau, SQL, SSRS, data visualization, analytics, and BI UX design. The role will work with business, data, and technology teams to deliver scalable dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design, develop, and maintainPower BI and Tableau dashboards, reports, and analytical solutions.
* Work with multiple data sources to build interactive dashboards and reporting solutions.
* Gather business requirements and translate them into effective BI solutions.
* Develop complex SQL queries for data extraction, transformation, and analysis.
* Work with SQL Server, Amazon Redshift, Athena, MySQL, and/or Snowflake.
* Develop and maintain SSRS reports.
* Design advanced visualizations and apply BI, UX, and performance best practices.
* Identify and resolve data/reporting quality issues with data and source\-system teams.
* Provide technical guidance and manage multiple priorities in an Agile environment.


**Required Skills**
* 7\+ years of Business Intelligence development experience.
* 5\+ years of Power BI and SSRS development experience.
* 5\+ years of advanced SQL development experience across multiple RDBMS platforms.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Power BI and Tableau or QlikView.
* Advanced Tableau reporting experience including joins, subqueries, data blending, calculations, filters, and parameters.
* Experience with data modeling, data visualization, dashboard design, and reporting best practices.
* 2\+ years of BI UX design experience and 2\+ years of analytics experience.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Understanding ofsoftware development processes and Agile methodologies.

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
**Job Description:**
 We are seeking an experienced senior software engineer to drive complex feature enhancements, architecture improvements, and high\-tier escalation resolution for our enterprise security product suite. In this role, you will balance core software engineering—designing cross\-platform components, APIs, and distributed systems—with deep debugging and hotfix engineering for critical customer issues.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and implement new software components and new features that meet functional and business requirements on schedule and within budget.
* Utilize different programming languages to create cross\-platform code (UNIX, Linux, Mac, and Windows platforms) that will run in physical (hardware) and virtual environments (Azure and AWS).
* Define communication interfaces between software components, implement new product APIs, and consume 3rd party interfaces in product software components.
* Utilize network protocols and apply software clustering models to build distributed enterprise\-grade software that can be deployed and synchronized in multiple datacenters across the globe.
* Use Relational Databases (SQL) and Directories (LDAP). Design database tables and schemas to store product\-specific information and integrate the product with customers' provided databases and LDAP directories.
* Utilize modern UI frameworks for development of end\-user\-facing interfaces, web protocols, and REST APIs.
* Work collaboratively within an Agile Team to write high\-quality, testable code that meets the Definition of Done.
* Perform unit/module testing of software to find errors and confirm programs meet specifications.
* Utilize unit testing frameworks to build unit tests. Implement end\-to\-end automation tests.
* Provide information to technical writers and conduct training sessions on new modules or code changes to other members of the product cross\-functional team.
* Integrate new product features and tests into the continuous integration toolchain.
* Leverage AI\-assisted development tools and identify opportunities to adopt innovative technologies.
* Troubleshoot product issues, fix defects, and work closely with customers to drive platform quality.
* Utilize debugging and troubleshooting skills to resolve complex configuration issues or product defects reported by the customers.
* Work on recreating product issues in the lab environment and be able to troubleshoot issues in customer environments using remote tools.
* Provide guidance and best practices on product deployment models and configurations.
* Support regular cadence of product update releases such as service packs and produce individual hotfixes and code patches.


**Skills Required**
* Strong design, programming (Java, C, C\+\+, PHP, Perl, SQL, and shell scripts), and debugging skills with experience on enterprise\-class applications.
* Strong knowledge of Windows / Unix / Linux operating systems Internals and experience with cross\-platform software development
* Very good at debugging multi\-threaded, high\-performance applications
* Ability to use AI tools effectively to improve efficiency and productivity
* Enterprise Security domain knowledge and experience (authentication/authorization frameworks, security protocols, PKI, certificates, SSL, Privileged Access and Identity use cases)
* Good communication, coaching, and mentoring skills.


**Work Experience**
 Typically, 10\+ years of experience in software development
   

  

**What makes you a strong fit?
   

  

 AI Expertise:**
* You are an expert in using AI code assist tools (Claude/Cursor, etc.) as coworkers and not as prompt engineers.
* Good understanding of AI Spec\-driven development methodologies like Plan/BMAD mode, etc., and use it thoroughly to map out and implement all phases of SDLC.
* Understand agent orchestration and manage multi\-agent workflows to handle complex, multi\-step engineering tasks like new capabilities, codebase refactoring, upgrades, and vulnerability patching.
* Code Review \& Quality Control: Critically review AI\-generated code for architectural alignment, design, and performance bottlenecks.

title: Current Affairs Content Developer
description:
**Company Description** 
 CHESTA Institute is an online guidance platform dedicated to supporting aspirants preparing for Civil Services Exams. The institute focuses on delivering high\-quality, exam\-oriented learning resources and mentoring to help learners navigate complex current affairs topics. CHESTA emphasizes accessibility, flexibility, and clarity, enabling aspirants from diverse backgrounds to benefit from expert guidance. The team collaborates with subject matter experts to ensure that content remains accurate, up\-to\-date, and aligned with competitive exam requirements.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Current Affairs Content Developer will create, structure, and refine learning materials focused on national and international current events for Civil Services aspirants. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include researching reliable sources, writing and updating topic\-wise notes, drafting quizzes and practice questions, and organizing content into clear, exam\-relevant formats. The role also involves collaborating with academic mentors to align content with syllabus changes, incorporating learner feedback, and maintaining consistency in tone and difficulty level. This is a remote contract role, requiring regular online communication and timely delivery of assigned content modules.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Writing and Technical Writing skills to produce clear, accurate, and structured learning materials.
* Candidates should possess solid Content Development and Instructional Design skills to create engaging, exam\-focused modules and assessments.
* Candidates should possess effective Communication skills for collaborating with mentors, editors, and other team members in a remote environment.
* Strong understanding of current affairs, the Indian polity and economy, and Civil Services exam patterns is highly beneficial.
* Ability to conduct thorough research, verify sources, and summarize complex information for learners at different preparation levels.
* Prior experience in educational content creation, test preparation, or e\-learning is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Political Science, Public Administration, Journalism, or related disciplines preferred.
